description: PowerShell cmdlet to retrieve firewall rules by exact name or pattern from Windows Defender Firewall.
prerequisites: Admin privileges for full rule visibility

flags.example_command: Get-NetFirewallRule -Name "RemoteDesktop*" | Select DisplayName, Enabled, Direction, Action
flags.purpose: Retrieve firewall rules by exact name or wildcard.
flags.security_use_case: Audit sensitive services like RDP, SMB, WinRM for exposure.
flags.threat_detected: Lateral movement paths or brute force exposure.

flags.example_command: Get-NetFirewallRule -Enabled True | Select DisplayName, Direction, Action
flags.purpose: Show only active rules affecting traffic now.
flags.security_use_case: Quick review of live firewall behavior.

flags.example_command: Get-NetFirewallRule -Direction Inbound | Select DisplayName, Action, Profile
flags.threat_detected: Inbound allow rules on Public network.

flags.example_command: Get-NetFirewallRule -Action Allow | Select DisplayName, Direction, Enabled
Get-NetFirewallRule -Profile Public | Select DisplayName, Enabled, Action

flags.purpose: Identify whether rule comes from Local, GPO, or Persistent store.
flags.security_use_case: Detect malicious rules pushed via Group Policy.
flags.safe_followup: Review GPO or local policy source.

flags.purpose: Reveal ports and protocols used by rules.

flags.security_use_case: Detect rules allowing Any remote address.

powerful_combinations.command: Get-NetFirewallRule -Enabled True -Direction Inbound -Action Allow | Get-NetFirewallPortFilter | Select Name, LocalPort, Protocol
powerful_combinations.why_powerful: Shows exactly which inbound ports are open right now.
powerful_combinations.security_context: Detect exposed services vulnerable to exploitation.

powerful_combinations.command: Get-NetFirewallRule -Profile Public -Action Allow | Get-NetFirewallAddressFilter | Select Name, RemoteAddress
powerful_combinations.why_powerful: Finds rules allowing traffic from any IP on Public network.
powerful_combinations.security_context: Critical for laptop users on public Wi-Fi.

powerful_combinations.command: Get-NetFirewallRule | Get-NetFirewallApplicationFilter | Where {$_.Program -ne $null} | Select Name, Program
powerful_combinations.security_context: Malware persistence and C2 communication detection.

powerful_combinations.why_powerful: Reveals if rule came from GPO or local tampering.
